_comment: Rooms whose audio ALSO plays on their ESP32-S3 node box (additive beside the WS unit path — see node_audio_manager.py). server_host = this server's LAN address; nodes stream ALL audio from it (2026-07-25: nothing stored on nodes): ambience beds GET /api/audio/<file>, effect cues GET /api/audio/cues/<cue_id>.wav (volume-baked WAVs — sim/esphome/make_node_audio.py). Per room: host/port = the node's ESPHome native API. Mapped: the S3 bench node + Cop Dodge (first real box, 2026-07-25) — add rooms as their boxes are built.
